key_learnings: The e2e tests rely heavily on `#my-plan-name` existing and being properly populated before trying to evaluate other data such as the storage capacity that are hydrated by `/api/v1/billing/my-plan`.

If `.not.toHaveText('--')` is evaluated on a non-existent element, it succeeds immediately, which can cause race conditions. It is better to use `toHaveText('Free')` or wait until an actual element is properly rendered and contains the expected state.

The containerized sandbox environments for test execution might block Docker-in-Docker layer operations (e.g. `pgvector` container failing to mount overlayfs) so any local test invocations should bypass docker mounts if run within typical sandbox.
